name: ComfortDelGro Corporation Limited
summary: ComfortDelGro Corporation Limited (CDGLY), an investment holding company headquartered in Singapore, is a prominent global operator of public and private transport services. The company's diverse operations are segmented to cover a broad spectrum of services, including: Public and Private Transport: Delivering essential bus and rail services, along with extensive taxi and coach operations that encompass rental, advertising, and booking management. It also provides specialized non-emergency patient transport and charter bus services. Automotive and Engineering: Offering comprehensive vehicle maintenance, repair, and crash repair services, alongside bus body assembly and the construction of specialized vehicles. This segment also handles fuel sales and is actively developing electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure. Ancillary and Support Services: Providing critical motor vehicle and non-vehicle inspection, testing, and consultancy services. Additionally, it operates driving schools, manages car rental and leasing fleets, and offers financial services such as insurance broking, risk management, and charge card facilities. Building inspection and terminal management are also part of its portfolio. As of March 30, 2022, ComfortDelGro managed a substantial fleet of approximately 35,000 buses, taxis, and rental vehicles. While based in Singapore, its significant international presence extends to the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, China, New Zealand, and Malaysia. The company was incorporated in 2003.
